title: Demo app: filter the notes by text, in the API and on the page
notes: Acceptance. API: GET /api/notes?q=<text> returns only the notes whose text contains q, ignoring case; an empty or missing q returns every note. Page (src/notes_app/static/index.html): a text input with id #q above the list filters the notes as the person types, and clearing it shows every note again. Tests first: unit tests in tests/notes/ and a Playwright test in e2e/test_notes_app.py that adds three notes, types part of one text and sees only the matching notes. Keep the selectors #t #f #n #v, a single <button> element and the brand colour #0b5fff. The existing browser tests and e2e/test_notes_live.py must keep passing. Do not touch .gitlab-ci.yml.
